Its coloration is predominantly electric blue on the anterior half and head, transitioning to bright yellow-green on the posterior half and tail. There is a distinct black vertical bar separating the blue and yellow regions near the dorsal fin, and a black margin on the tail. The scales are clearly visible with a textured pattern. The eye is large and prominent. The mouth is small and pointed.
